# Results — Study 773 (Spotify-Wrapped)

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). The claim under test —
**Spotify (SPOT) rallies into its December "Wrapped" launch**: the viral year-in-review
campaign is supposed to bid the stock up as attention builds, then maybe fade after.
Offline & deterministic once cached; run `python examples/verify.py` to reproduce every
number. As-of **2026-06-30** (the last complete calendar month). Fingerprint
`ee0e942455bb` (SPOT + SPY, one combined panel, adjusted/total-return daily closes).*

## Data stamp

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Real tape | yfinance daily adjusted (total-return) closes, `SPOT` (Spotify) + `SPY` (S&P 500), one combined panel: 2,072 rows, 2018-04-03 → 2026-06-30 |
| Calendar | **hardcoded**: 10 Spotify Wrapped launches 2016→2025, real dates (Spotify Newsroom / Wikipedia "Spotify Wrapped"); rollout clusters Nov 29 → Dec 6 |
| Events resolvable | **8** of 10 launches have SPOT+SPY coverage around the anchor (2016 & 2017 excluded — before the SPOT direct listing on 2018-04-03) |
| Statistics | one-sample *t* of the abnormal return (SPOT − SPY) across independent, non-overlapping yearly events (the correct unit — not a daily panel); Wilson hit-rate interval; a 20-seed × 200-draw random-window placebo per cut; leave-one-out jackknife |
| Execution / costs | **calendar-known, zero look-ahead**: Wrapped ships in the same late-Nov/early-Dec slot every year. Run-up = [anchor−K → anchor]; fade = [anchor → anchor+K]; net of 2× one-way cost × NAV. Gross AND net reported |
| Price basis | **total-return** (dividends reinvested, `auto_adjust=True`) for both legs |

**Small-n caveat, named:** SPOT only lists in April 2018, so this test has **n = 8**
independent events — a genuinely thin sample. Every *t* below is a small-sample statistic
and the honest false-positive rate is elevated (the synthetic control fires |*t*| ≥ 2 on
~1/5 of pure-null seeds at n = 18, worse at n = 8). Read the point estimates, not the
decimals.

## The run-up — abnormal return, K sessions BEFORE the launch (SPOT − SPY)

| cut | n | mean AR | *t* | hit rate (Wilson 95%) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 2-week run-up (k=10) | 8 | −0.676% | −0.177 | 5/8 = 62.5% [30.6%, 86.3%] |
| 1-month run-up (k=21) | 8 | −1.940% | −0.373 | 3/8 = 37.5% [13.7%, 69.4%] |

The bullish "rally into Wrapped" folklore is **absent**: both run-up windows are *negative*
on average, and neither is remotely distinguishable from zero (|*t*| < 0.4). The 2-week
hit rate is 5/8 but the mean is still negative — a couple of big down-years drag it — and
the Wilson band [30.6%, 86.3%] comfortably straddles a coin flip. There is no pre-launch
rally.

## The fade — abnormal return, K sessions AFTER the launch

| cut | n | mean AR | *t* | hit rate (Wilson 95%) |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| 2-week fade (k=10) | 8 | +0.614% | +0.239 | 4/8 = 50.0% [21.5%, 78.5%] |
| 1-month fade (k=21) | 8 | +0.324% | +0.152 | 4/8 = 50.0% [21.5%, 78.5%] |

The "sell the news" half is a **clean zero** too — post-launch SPOT is statistically
indistinguishable from SPY (both cuts |*t*| < 0.25, hit rate a dead 50/50). There is no
fade to short.

## Random-window placebo (20 seeds × 200 draws per event)

| cut | tail | observed | placebo mean (sd) | p |
|---|---|--:|--:|--:|
| 2-week run-up | right | −0.676% | +0.399% (2.886%) | 0.6352 |
| 2-week fade | left | +0.614% | +0.399% (2.886%) | 0.5373 |

Both observed means sit **dead-centre** of the luck cloud (p ≈ 0.64 and 0.54). Neither the
run-up nor the fade is anything other than ordinary SPOT-vs-SPY tracking noise. Note the
placebo sd (2.9%) dwarfs every observed effect — SPOT's two-week idiosyncratic swings are
several times larger than any "Wrapped" tilt.

## Jackknife (leave-one-out) — 2-week run-up *t*

Full-sample *t* = **−0.177**; across all 8 leave-one-out draws the *t* ranges
**[−0.817, +0.424]** — it straddles zero and even flips sign depending on which single
year you drop. There is no robust effect to be stable *about*.

## Tradability — net of costs (calendar-known entry, zero look-ahead)

| window | gross | net @ 5 bps | net @ 10 bps |
|---|--:|--:|--:|
| 2-week run-up | −0.676% (*t* −0.18) | −0.776% (*t* −0.20) | −0.876% (*t* −0.23) |
| 2-week fade | +0.614% (*t* +0.24) | +0.514% (*t* +0.20) | +0.414% (*t* +0.16) |

Nothing survives because there is nothing gross to begin with. Every cut is an
insignificant sub-1% wisp on 8 events, swamped by a 2.9% window-noise sd; costs only nudge
already-zero numbers.

## Synthetic positive control (deterministic, no network)

- **Null (bump = 0), 20 seeds:** mean *t* = −0.43 (sd 1.43); |*t*| ≥ 2 in **4/20** seeds —
  the honest small-sample false-positive rate at n = 18 synthetic events with a 10-day AR
  is elevated (~20%), and the real study's n = 8 is thinner still.
- **Planted run-up +1.0% (seed 777):** mean AR +1.19%, *t* = **+1.37**.
- **Planted run-up +2.0% (seed 777):** mean AR +2.19%, *t* = **+2.52** — a real bump is
  recovered monotonically. The detector works; the SPOT tape simply has no bump to find.

## Verdict

| Axis | Stamp | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **Signal — is the effect real?** | **None** | Both the run-up (−0.68% / −1.94%, |*t*| < 0.4) and the fade (+0.61% / +0.32%, |*t*| < 0.25) are indistinguishable from zero; the placebo puts the observed means dead-centre of the luck cloud (p ≈ 0.64, 0.54); the jackknife *t* straddles and flips sign; and the whole thing rests on just n = 8 post-IPO events. The synthetic control confirms the detector *would* catch a real bump — there isn't one. |
| **Tradability — survives costs/scale?** | **Mirage** | Nothing to bank. There is no gross edge, the effect sign-flips across horizon and leave-one-out, and any position would be dwarfed by SPOT's ~2.9% two-week idiosyncratic noise. Costs are moot. |

**In one sentence:** the "buy Spotify into its Wrapped launch" idea is folklore — across the
8 post-IPO Wrapped seasons SPOT neither rallies into the launch (it mildly, insignificantly
sags) nor fades after; every cut is dead-centre of its own noise and vanishes under a
leave-one-out.
